name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: copywriting_optimization
prompts.template: Generate persuasive marketing copy focused on {marketing_objective} using keywords: {seo_keywords}.
prompts.use_case: Automating creation of high-converting marketing copy

prompts.name: seo_content_strategy
prompts.template: Create an SEO content strategy targeting these keywords: {seo_keywords} with a focus on {marketing_objective}.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing website or campaign SEO through AI-driven keyword strategies

prompts.name: analytics_insights
prompts.template: Analyze the following marketing analytics data and provide a performance report: {analytics_data}.
prompts.use_case: Generating actionable growth engineering plans for startups

prompts.name: growth_plan_generation
prompts.template: Develop a growth engineering plan to achieve: {marketing_objective} based on input data and best practices.
prompts.use_case: Analyzing marketing analytics data to inform strategy
